name: "NuGet"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: 'Find and download the packages, but do not publish them'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

# No permissions by default; the job asks for what it needs.
permissions: {}

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Publish Packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      id-token: write # enable GitHub OIDC token issuance for trusted publishing
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:

    # The packages are the nugetPackages-<branch> artifact of the Build workflow. Only a build of that branch
    # uploads it, so the newest one is the latest build. It is published only if it is a build of the commit
    # this workflow runs on and its run succeeded: started before the build of the latest commit finished,
    # this workflow would otherwise publish an older build.
    - name: Find the build to publish
      id: build
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        ARTIFACT: nugetPackages-${{ github.ref_name }}
      run: |
        artifact=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts?name=$ARTIFACT&per_page=100" \
          --jq '[.artifacts[] | select(.expired | not)] | sort_by(.created_at) | last')
        if [ -z "$artifact" ] || [ "$artifact" = "null" ]; then
          echo "::error::No $ARTIFACT artifact found."
          exit 1
        fi

        run_id=$(jq -r '.workflow_run.id' <<< "$artifact")
        sha=$(jq -r '.workflow_run.head_sha' <<< "$artifact")
        branch=$(jq -r '.workflow_run.head_branch' <<< "$artifact")
        run=$(gh run view "$run_id" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json workflowName,event,status,conclusion,url)
        echo "Newest $ARTIFACT: run $(jq -r .url <<< "$run"), branch $branch, commit $sha"

        if [ "$(jq -r .workflowName <<< "$run")" != "Build" ]; then
          echo "::error::The artifact was not uploaded by the Build workflow."
          exit 1
        fi
        # A scheduled run builds nightly-builds but is recorded as a run of the default branch.
        if [ "$(jq -r .event <<< "$run")" = "schedule" ] || [ "$branch" != "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" ]; then
          echo "::error::The artifact comes from a scheduled run or from another branch than $GITHUB_REF_NAME."
          exit 1
        fi
        if [ "$sha" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then
          # A push that changes only Markdown files or this workflow does not start a Build.
          echo "::error::The newest build is of $sha, not of $GITHUB_SHA. Wait for the Build run of $GITHUB_SHA to finish, or start the Build workflow on $GITHUB_REF_NAME if it did not run."
          exit 1
        fi
        if [ "$(jq -r .status <<< "$run")" != "completed" ]; then
          echo "::error::The Build run of $GITHUB_SHA is still running. Wait for it to finish."
          exit 1
        fi
        if [ "$(jq -r .conclusion <<< "$run")" != "success" ]; then
          echo "::error::The Build run of $GITHUB_SHA did not succeed."
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "run-id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    - name: Download Artifacts
      uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
      with:
        name: nugetPackages-${{ github.ref_name }}
        run-id: ${{ steps.build.outputs.run-id }}
        github-token: ${{ github.token }}

    - name: Display structure of downloaded files
      run: ls -R

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
